newsitem.title: USA: EMC sees $200 mln revs in '96 from Symmetrix.
newsitem.headline: EMC sees $200 mln revs in '96 from Symmetrix.

text.p: EMC Corp expects another $100 million in sales the remainder of calendar 1996 from its Symmetrix mainframe data migration services to total $200 million for the year, a spokesman said.
Sales of software, services and storage systems related to Symmetrix Data Migration Services totalled $100 million during the nine months since its conception, said David Farmer, an EMC spokesman.

Over the last nine months, EMC customers have migrated from more than 600 older storage devices onto 200 Symmetrix mainframe storage systems, and EMC expects the number of migrations to double over the remaining four months of the year, Farmer said.
"EMC hasn't provided this level of detail, however Wall Street's understanding of EMC's growth for the remainder of the year reflect these numbers," Farmer said.
